projects.title: Quantum Trackback
projects.description: Optimized original project with a Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (QCNN) to better compare high-dimensional data. Leveraged quantum entanglement and superposition of qubits, achieving a 23.63% increase in accuracy.

projects.title: Tracking Microplastics VIA Remote Sensing and Mathematical Analysis
projects.description: Integrated a Feature Pyramid Neural Network (FPN) with Navier-Stokes fluid equations to track microplastics. Utilized TensorFlow and MATLAB to analyze data from NASA’s Earth Science database, achieving 67.87% accuracy.

projects.title: LockUp
projects.description: LockUp is a precision medicine startup that helps combat mental health issues by leveraging Zero Knowledge Proofs and Blockchain to encrypt sensitive data. This cutting-edge technology will ensure that more patients with mental health issues will be open to therapy.

activity.title: Just got accepted into Y Combinator's Startup School 2026. Two days in San Francisco. A room full of the most cracked builders on the planet, and a lineup of the founders who actually built the companies the rest of us study. I'm going in with one goal: shut up, listen hard, and meet as many people as I can. If you'll be at Startup School, in SF that week, or just want to chat, please feel free to reach out. I'm excited to start sharing my journey with you all. More on that soon. See you in SF!

hi everyone i graduated a few months ago, and now i am an ML researcher at Apple on the Foundation Models team, working on responsible AI and safety! soon, billions (!!) of devices will have access to increasingly intelligent on-device and cloud models. excited to work on making these models worthy of the trust people will place in them. lately i’ve been especially interested in safety evals, including how we can efficiently sample rare but dangerous trajectories. if you’re interested in similar problems (or just want to be friends!), please reach out :)

T-4 days until the World's First Ever Zero Human Company Hackathon. Today, we're excited to bring Whop on board as one of our amazing sponsors. Whop is the end-to-end API for running a business on the internet. RSVP in the comments!

had a great surprise conversation with Sam Altman the other day in front of hundreds of Silicon Valley interns We talked about: - turning down Goldman Sachs and dropping out of Stanford - how he got Peter Thiel and Paul Graham to take 19-year-old Sam seriously - advice for young people - the version of ChatGPT he is looking most forward to...and more https://lnkd.in/gDvS_ZEB

After 9.5 incredible years at AWS, last week I said goodbye to my time as an Amazonian. To my teammates, the leaders and mentors who guided me, the customers who placed their trust in me, and the friends who became family along the way, thank you for supporting and challenging me. It was a privilege to work alongside some of the world’s largest organizations through their cloud transformation and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes. Now, I couldn’t be more excited to join OpenAI at a time when frontier AI is reshaping how we work, innovate, and some of the world’s biggest challenges. I’m also grateful that AWS and so many people that I’ve had opportunity to work alongside will continue to be an important part of this journey.

Grateful for the opportunity to hear from Metro’s executive leadership and gain insights into leadership, professional growth, and the future of public transit. Thank you to everyone who made this experience possible!

These past 10 weeks at Capital One have been an exceptional experience. Over the summer, I had the opportunity to work on integrating Cube.js - streamlining data accessibility, unifying key metrics, and empowering teams to query data for efficiently with LLMs. It was a fantastic technical challenge that gave me hands-on experience with modern data architecture and building tools at scale. None of it would have been the same without the people. A huge thank you to my manager, Eric F. for his guidance and mentorship throughout the summer. A special shoutout to my “cube-icle” teammates, Ishika Aggarwal and Henry Yu , for making every day in the office so collaborative and fun, as well as the extended team - Mani Eswaran , Amos Komo , and Michael Monschke - for always jumping in with support and expertise. And of course, thank you to my recruiter Jennifer Skinner for making this happen. Excited to carry everything I’ve learned into my next chapter!
